values: 对所有敌人造成伤害并展开魔法阵并持续消耗能量提高激活度，完全激活后加拉哈德额外获得增益。魔法阵持续至加拉哈德离开其中心位置，并且当加拉哈德处于魔法阵中心时释放技能会召唤残影额外模仿自身技能。

Galahad deals damage to all enemies and creates a magic circle that consumes Energy as it forms. When the circle reaches full power, she gains a buff. The circle stays active as long as Galahad remains at its center. While she is at the center, whenever she casts a skill, a shadow appears that casts the same skill.

使用终极技能时，立即消耗400点能量，对所有敌人造成340% + 50% ATK伤害，随后在自身位置展开半径2格的魔法阵持续至自身离开其中心位置。魔法阵持续期间每秒消耗加拉哈德60点能量以提高10%激活度，激活度达到100%后不再消耗能量并使加拉哈德提高30点急速。魔法阵每有10%激活度，使区域内的敌人降低10点急速和16%移动速度，最多降低50点急速和80%移动速度。加拉哈德位于魔法阵中心释放技能后会召唤自身残影再次释放该技能，残影继承自身60% + 5%属性。

When Galahad casts her Ultimate, she consumes 400 Energy to deal 340% + 50% ATK damage to all enemies. She then begins forming a 2-tile-radius magic circle centered on her position. The circle remains active as long as Galahad stays at its center.
While the magic circle is forming, Galahad consumes 60 Energy every second to increase the circle's forming progress by 10%. When the forming progress reaches 100%, she stops consuming Energy and gains 30 Haste.
Enemies inside the magic circle lose 10 Haste and 16% movement speed for every 10% of the circle's forming progress, up to a max reduction of 50 Haste and 80% movement speed.
While Galahad stays at the center of her circle, whenever she casts a skill, a shadow of herself appears shortly after and casts the same skill. The shadow inherits 60% + 5% of Galahad's stats.
Increases the damage dealt to 380% + 50% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 420% + 50% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 460% + 50% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 500% + 50% ATK.
禁锢累计伤害最高的敌人，失去其累计受到治疗量一部分的生命，随后对更大范围内的敌人造成伤害。
Galahad immobilizes the enemy who has dealt the highest cumulative damage, causing them to lose HP based on the healing they have received. Then she deals damage to enemies in a wider range.
禁锢敌方累计伤害最高的目标4秒并对其造成210% + 30% ATK伤害，被禁锢的敌人无法行动，同时加拉哈德使其失去上次受到该技能效果后累计受到的非溢出治疗量50%的生命值，最高不超过500% ATK，在挑战首领的模式中，该效果改为固定使敌人失去125% ATK生命值。随后加拉哈德扩大1格伤害范围对并范围内所有敌人造成140% + 20% ATK伤害，重复2次。

Galahad deals 210% + 30% ATK damage to the enemy who has dealt the highest cumulative damage and immobilizes them for 4s. The immobilized target cannot move or act and loses HP equal to 50% of the non-excess healing they have received since they were last immobilized by this skill; the HP loss cannot exceed 500% ATK. In boss fights, the HP loss becomes fixed at 125% ATK.
After the initial strike, Galahad expands this skill's range by 1 tile and deals 140% + 20% ATK damage to all enemies within range. She then repeats the sequence for a third strike.
对禁锢目标造成的伤害提高至240% + 30% ATK伤害，扩大攻击范围后造成的伤害提高至160% + 20% ATK。
Increases initial strike damage to 240% + 30% ATK and damage of the following two strikes to 160% + 20% ATK.
对禁锢目标造成的伤害提高至270% + 30% ATK伤害，扩大攻击范围后造成的伤害提高至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases initial strike damage to 270% + 30% ATK and damage of the following two strikes to 180% + 20% ATK.
对禁锢目标造成的伤害提高至300% + 30% ATK伤害，扩大攻击范围后造成的伤害提高至200% + 20% ATK。
Increases initial strike damage to 300% + 30% ATK and damage of the following two strikes to 200% + 20% ATK.
为最虚弱的友军添加护盾，并且在护盾结束时对周围敌人造成伤害。
Galahad grants a shield to the weakest ally. When the shield expires, it deals damage to nearby enemies.
对最虚弱的友军施加巫术庇护，为其添加480% + 40% ATK的护盾持续8秒，护盾在消失时对周围1格范围内的敌人造成240% + 20% ATK伤害。
Galahad casts a protection spell on the weakest ally, granting them a 480% + 40% ATK shield that lasts for 8s. When the shield expires, it deals 240% + 20% ATK damage to adjacent enemies.
护盾量提高至520% + 40% ATK，伤害提高至260% + 20% ATK。
Increases the shield value to 520% + 40% ATK and the damage dealt when the shield expires to 260% + 20% ATK.
护盾量提高至560% + 40% ATK，伤害提高至280% + 20% ATK。
Increases the shield value to 560% + 40% ATK and the damage dealt when the shield expires to 280% + 20% ATK.
护盾量提高至600% + 40% ATK，伤害提高至300% + 20% ATK。
Increases the shield value to 600% + 40% ATK and the damage dealt when the shield expires to 300% + 20% ATK.
提高自身攻击力，魔法阵完全激活后额外提升攻击力。
Galahad increases her ATK, with an extra ATK increase when her magic circle is fully formed.
战斗中，加拉哈德提高9%攻击力，当加拉哈德展开的魔法阵激活度达到100%后，额外提高6%攻击力。
Galahad increases her ATK by 9% during battle. She also gains an extra 6% ATK when her magic circle is fully formed.
战斗中，加拉哈德提高12%攻击力，当加拉哈德展开的魔法阵激活度达到100%后，额外提高8%攻击力。
Galahad increases her ATK by 12% during battle. She also gains an extra 8% ATK when her magic circle is fully formed.
战斗中，加拉哈德提高15%攻击力，当加拉哈德展开的魔法阵激活度达到100%后，额外提高10%攻击力。
Galahad increases her ATK by 15% during battle. She also gains an extra 10% ATK when her magic circle is fully formed.
在魔法阵完全激活后召唤一名友方英雄战斗开始一段时间的残影协助作战。
Once the magic circle is fully formed, Galahad summons a shadow of an allied hero from the start of battle to fight alongside her for a while.
战斗开始时标记布阵时距离自己最近的一名友方英雄（相同距离下优先选择更靠近自己身后的友方英雄）。当加拉哈德终极技能展开的魔法阵首次激活度达到100%时，召唤该友军战斗开始时的残影持续12秒，残影继承其本体80%的基础属性，具有额外400点初始能量，不算作存活英雄且不会被敌人攻击。

When a battle starts, Galahad marks the nearest allied hero, prioritizing the one behind her. When Galahad's magic circle is fully formed for the first time, she summons a shadow that recreates the marked ally as they were at the start of battle.
The shadow remains on the battlefield for 12s, inheriting 80% of the ally's basic stats and starting with 400 extra Initial Energy. A shadow is not considered a living hero and cannot be targeted by enemies.
该残影继承的基础属性提高至100%。
The summoned shadow now inherits 100% of the marked ally's basic stats.
当加拉哈德终极技能展开的魔法阵首次激活度达到100%时，己方梅林释放技能施加的属性增益效力提高20%且持续时间延长100%，并且每次释放技能后会由梅林的残影再次释放对应技能，残影造成的生命损耗量为梅林原技能的60%

When Galahad's magic circle is fully formed for the first time, Magister Merlin's skills grant stat buffs that are 20% stronger and last 100% longer. Every time Magister Merlin casts a skill, a shadow of Merlin appears nearby and casts the same skill again, causing 60% as much HP loss as Merlin's original skill does.
该残影继承的基础属性提高至120%。
The summoned shadow now inherits 120% of the marked ally's basic stats.
自身处于己方梅林施加的增益时会持续恢复能量并获得稳定状态。
Galahad continuously recovers Energy and becomes steadfast while affected by Merlin's buffs.
当加拉哈德处于己方梅林施加的增益状态时，每秒恢复40点能量并处于稳定状态，通过该技能获得的稳定状态最多持续30秒。
While Galahad is affected by Merlin's buffs, she recovers 40 Energy per second and becomes steadfast. The steadfast effect granted by this skill cannot exceed a total of 30s.
